_meta.author: c2j
_meta.review_notes: Q57 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM payment_date) = 3) -> Aggregate -> Partition Iterator (Iterations: 7) -> Partitioned Seq Scan on payment with Filter '(date_part('month'::text, payment_date) = 3::double precision)', Rows Removed by Filter: 13336, Selected Partitions: 1..7. The payment table is range-partitioned by month into 7 partitions (2022-01..2022-07). PART-001 fires via Case 1 ('detail_function' branch): node is PartitionedSeqScan, has Filter, filter_contains_function is true (filter value contains 'date_part'), parse_partition_range('1..7') = (1,7), n_scanned = 7-1+1 = 7, start(1) <= 1 AND n_scanned(7) >= end(7) AND filter_has_function -> pruning_failed. detail template 'detail_function' with count=7, range='1..7'. SCAN-001 does NOT fire (Q57 has Filter property -> SCAN-001 short-circuits on has_filter). SCAN-005 does NOT fire (rule only matches IndexScan/IndexOnlyScan/CStoreIndexScan/PartitionedIndexScan, not PartitionedSeqScan). GEN-001 does NOT fire (plan depth = 3 < threshold 10). PUSH-001 does NOT fire (no Streaming node; query is trivially shipped / locally executed). NOTE: SCAN-004 also co-fires (rows_removed=13336 > min_rows_removed=500) but is intentionally not declared here because the case targets PART-001 contract; undeclared co-firings are allowed by the harness.

anti_findings.reason: SCAN-001 (LargeTableFullScan) short-circuits on has_filter=true; Q57's Partitioned Seq Scan has a Filter property (Filtered scans belong to SCAN-004).
SCAN-005 (IndexScanPoorSelectivity) only matches IndexScan / IndexOnlyScan / CStoreIndexScan / PartitionedIndexScan. Q57 is a Partitioned Seq Scan.
GEN-001 (PlanTooDeep) fires when plan depth exceeds max_plan_depth (default 10). Q57 depth = 3 (Aggregate -> Partition Iterator -> Partitioned Seq Scan).
PUSH-001 (QueryNotPushedDown) requires a Streaming(...) node to signal FQS failure. Q57's plan has no Streaming node (single-node centralized plan, no redistribution).
